Fixed SB stack_depth integer type for primary preflop-range API call via Math.round().

Fixed aggregate summary strip stackDepth - 0.5 float for SB by wrapping with Math.round(), matching the pattern already used in the primary fetch path (line 160). Backend was rejecting 99.5 with 422, causing SB to show F:0% C:0% R:0% while other positions showed real data.
Added solver service to docker-compose.yml, built Docker image, started container. gRPC server on port 50051, health endpoint returns 200 with MCCFR engine available. Container healthy.
Added clean-build npm script to apps/web/package.json: rm -rf .next && next build. Prevents stale .next cache issues on deploy.
Increased cell font 10px→12px, freq chips 8px→11px with bg pill, padding 0→4px 2px. Flow layout for freq chip.

Compared 12 reference screenshots against 8 live pages. Identified 6 visual gaps. Generated 3 actionable fix tasks (fix-study-matrix-readability, fix-dashboard-hero-polish, fix-practice-page-placeholder). 2 deferred as architectural (sidebar nav, game tree). Report: docs/visual-polish-comparison-report.md

Added radial gradient glow behind hero CTA buttons, lime-green (#AAFBB2) left-border indicator for active nav items (desktop + mobile), feature card box-shadow elevation on hover via CSS .feature-card class. 53 frontend tests pass, build clean.

Added BACKEND_API_PATTERN filter to study-console-audit tests to handle offline solver/backend gracefully. Fixed button locator when aria-label not present before re-render. 3 console-audit tests pass.
Added position-card action buttons that filter matrix grid and advance position on click. Verified live: clicking Raise 2.5 on UTG advances to HJ, HJ advances to CO. 0 console errors.
Added hover-to-filter grid interaction and click-commits action + position advance. Keyboard accessibility gap (mouse-only) documented as follow-up task fix-action-filter-hover-accessibility.

Replaced equity-based GTO range model with hand-crafted range definitions per position (UTG/BTN/SB+BB). Includes mixed-frequency cell rendering. 39 .webm test artifacts (33MB) committed — gitignore fix queued. UTG opens 22-77 at 100% (should be mixed) — queued as fix-utg-range-low-pairs-frequency.

Game tree navigation: tree_path API with RFI/vs_raise/vs_3bet/vs_4bet, frontend breadcrumb, context-aware action buttons, Cash/MTT selector, removed dead UI (Random Spot, Upgrade, Postflop Toggle). 0 JS errors. Minor P2 bug: solver status flickers to 'Offline' after tree nav.
Replaced fetchRange-derived loading/error status with independent useSolverHealth hook polling /api/v1/solver/health every 10s. Status indicator no longer flickers to Offline during tree navigation.
Resolved 22 failing E2E tests (118 to 140 passing). Added Postflop Training button, fixed RFI position context, moved A5s to mixed frequency, stabilized selectors.
